newsitem.title: UK: Salomon gets European leveraged finance unit.
newsitem.headline: Salomon gets European leveraged finance unit.

text.p: Salomon Brothers International, a unit of Salomon Inc, said it had established a European acquisition and leveraged finance unit in its European Investment Banking division based in London.
It has appointed Bruce Roe to head the unit. He was previously at Credit Suisse First Boston.
Salomon said the establishment of the European unit completes the build up of its world-wide acquisition and leveraged/high-yield finance capability.

It said the development of a leading European presence in these fields is a top priority with the firm in its attempt to underwrite and distribute debt products across the senior, mezzanine, high-yield and bridge loan markets in the region.
